'Beatles' : '', values: [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.innerText?.trim()).map(e => e.innerText.trim()).filter(t => /Beatles|song|Yesterday|Hey Jude|Let It Be/i.test(t)).slice(-20), answer: ''}))

await page.evaluate(() => { const all = [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.innerText?.trim()); const hits = all.filter(e => /beatles/i.test(e.innerText)); const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"],button,a')].map(e => ({text:e.innerText?.trim(), role:e.getAttribute('role'), cls:e.className?.toString().slice(0,80)})).filter(e => e.text); return {url:location.href,title:document.title,h1:document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText, key_text:'Tabs demo', values:[document.body.innerText.slice(0,7000),hits.map(e=>({text:e.innerText,parent:e.parentElement?.outerHTML.slice(0,500)})),tabs.slice(0,60)],answer:''} })

await page.evaluate(() => { const matches=[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0 && /Beatles/i.test(e.textContent||'')); return matches.map(e=>({text:e.textContent.trim(), html:e.parentElement?.outerHTML.slice(0,1000)})); }); await page.getByRole('link',{name:'Basic'}).click(); await page.evaluate(() => ({url:location.href,title:document.title,h1:document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText,key_text:'Basic',values:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab],button')].map(e=>e.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,40),answer:''}))

await page.evaluate(() => { const tab=[...document.querySelectorAll('.n-tabs-tab')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='the Beatles'); if(tab) tab.click(); }); await page.evaluate(() => { const body=document.body.innerText; const i=body.indexOf('the Beatles'); const segment=body.slice(i,i+600); return {url:location.href,title:document.title,h1:document.querySelector('h1')?.innerText,key_text:'the Beatles',values:[segment],answer:segment.split('\n').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(1,5).join(' ')} })
